name: issuecreator
summary: Create actionable GitHub issues that issueflow can take through planning and implementation.
description: Create GitHub issues grounded in repository evidence and formatted for issueflow. Use when the user says "create an issue", "turn this into a GitHub issue", "write an issue for issueflow", or "break this work into issues". Supports local drafts and authorized publishing; implementing existing issues belongs to issueflow.
oneRule: Never present an issue as ready for implementation when its desired outcome, scope, or testable acceptance criteria remain unresolved.

commands.name: validate
commands.does: Validate a structured issue draft, reporting missing required fields, empty acceptance criteria, unresolved blocking questions, and placeholder content.

commands.name: render
commands.does: Render validated structured input to a GitHub Markdown body and metadata locally, preserving literal code and multiline text.

commands.name: create
commands.does: Publish a validated issue to an explicit owner/repository through gh using argument arrays and a body file, then read back its title, body, number and URL. Save a receipt and stop on ambiguous failures instead of blindly retrying.

deterministic.step: Check structural readiness without claiming semantic correctness
Create and read back the GitHub issue

nondeterministic.step: Inspect repository instructions, relevant code, tests, issue templates and related issues
nondeterministic.why: Which evidence matters depends on the requested change and repository conventions.

nondeterministic.step: Write the smallest independently implementable scope with observable acceptance criteria
nondeterministic.why: Intent, tradeoffs, dependencies and semantic completeness require judgment.

nondeterministic.step: Resolve consequential unknowns and distinguish observations from implementation suggestions
nondeterministic.why: A populated template cannot establish that claims are true or that an issue is actionable.

references.is: Issue body contract: problem and impact; desired behavior; in-scope and out-of-scope work; verified repository context; acceptance checklist; verification plan; dependencies and consequential open questions. Bug issues additionally include reproduction, expected/actual behavior and available environment details. Respect repository issue templates and avoid invented evidence.

evalPlan.pinnedAgainst: A real local draft of this requested issuecreator skill addition, researched against this checkout and rendered during implementation; no GitHub issue is posted merely to test the skill.
evalPlan.catches: Lost acceptance criteria, scope, evidence, multiline formatting or validation behavior when rerendering the captured input offline.

evalPlan.pinnedAgainst: The captured real draft with acceptance criteria removed or a blocking question added.
evalPlan.catches: Accepting structurally incomplete input as ready to publish.

evalPlan.pinnedAgainst: Offline gh test doubles covering literal shell metacharacters, read-back mismatches and ambiguous create failures.
evalPlan.catches: Shell interpolation, false publication claims and automatic duplicate creation.
